def build_session_cookie(token: str, expires_at: float, secure: bool, cookie_name: str) -> str:

   parts = [f"{cookie_name}={token}", "HttpOnly", "SameSite=Strict", "Path=/", f"Max-Age={max_age}"]
   if secure: parts.append("Secure")
